info.title: Agents API
info.description: Call the models with an API key: OpenAI-compatible `/models` and `/chat/completions` (with caller-executed tools, for coding clients), Open Responses `/responses`, and agent events. The agent and skill management endpoints use an OIDC token. Base URL: `<site>/api/agents/v1`.

servers.description: Relative to where this document is served (`/api/openapi.json`), so it resolves under any deployment base path.

get.summary: List the models this key can call
get.description: The models of the menu this user may use (including local and private ones they have access to), then the agents shared with them. Use `id` as `model`.

post.description: Works with OpenAI SDKs and coding clients by setting the base URL and key. Image, video and voice generation are not available here. Usage is charged to the account like chat.

200.description: The completion, or a stream of chunks when `stream` is true

schema.description: Server-Sent Events, one `data: {chat.completion.chunk}` per line pair and a final `data: [DONE]`. The first chunk carries `delta.role`, text arrives in `delta.content`, reasoning in `delta.reasoning`, and caller tool calls in `delta.tool_calls` (by `index`, with `id`, `type`, `function.name`, then `function.arguments`). The last chunk carries `finish_reason` and `usage`. An error after streaming started arrives as a final content chunk followed by `[DONE]`.

apiKey.description: An API key created in Settings → API keys, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. The account needs API access (admin switch, pack or role) and credit.

oidcBearer.description: An OIDC access token, sent as a bearer token.

content.description: The file content. The accepted maximum is 1 MiB (1,048,576 bytes) of UTF-8-encoded content. The limit is measured in bytes, not characters, so non-ASCII content reaches it at fewer characters.
